Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Local-runs: probe — one read-only substring count over the eval JSON at this head and at `origin/main` 6e287974 through `git show`, to check the PR body's re-measure table as the brief asks; nothing built, tested or re-run, no gate executed
Scope: skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json, skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json, skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json + none

The diff is five files, +14 / -4: one `expected_output` line in each of the four `hits` files and one changeset. No file in the diff implements or enforces the evals (no gate, validator or schema is touched), so the implementing set is empty. The changeset is the lane seat's remainder.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: unchanged. No `must_contain` or `must_not_contain` entry, prompt or id moves in any of the four files; only the reference answer text does. Right.
- Public surface: the four eval fixtures ship in `@objectstack/skills`; no SKILL.md, rule file, schema or runtime path is touched. Right.
- Each reference answer now passes its own grader, read at the head: flows-triggers-approvals 20 holds all 4 `must_contain` and none of 3 `must_not_contain`; integrations-declared 2 holds all 7 and none of 4 (`type: 'http'`, `registerConnector(`, `token:`, `Authorization: 'Bearer`); filters-pagination-search 2 holds all 4 and none of 2 (`cursor:`, `offset: page`; the text says `query.cursor`, which is not `cursor:`); analytics-inline-vs-dataset 1 holds all 4 and none of 2 (`valueField:`, `categoryField`; the text says `object/valueField/aggregate`, no colon). Right.
- Re-measure claim, checked against the tree: at `origin/main` 6e287974 the evals with a missing literal are automation 2, query 1, ui 1, data 3, objectui 17, and one `must_not_contain` hit (ui `views-apps-actions-pages` eval 2); at this head the four are gone and data 3, objectui 17 and the one hit are unchanged. Eval totals 25 / 7 / 29 / 37 / 59 / 34 match. The PR body's table is right, with "misses" counted in evals (in literals the data bundle is 6 and objectui 27).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/33588-skills-evals-own-literals.md` declares `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. The diff publishes reworded eval fixture text only, with no authorable or runtime surface change: patch is the right level. `Clause-②: no` is on the PR body and the changeset, and is right: nothing narrows, nothing is removed, no accept-set moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty.
- Deviation, model tier (authored on an opus session where `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates the contract tier for `skills/**`): answered by this record, rendered at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on the whole `hits` set.
- Deviation, signature as a plain line and not an HTML comment; no labels sent; model-free commit trailer: process choices with no effect on the tree; accepted.
- Out-of-scope finding, ui `views-apps-actions-pages` eval 2 contains its own `must_not_contain` literal `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'`: confirmed at this head; correctly left to card #33560, whose surface the file is.
- Out-of-scope finding, a shape check as a gate: correctly not added; the card rules it the maintainer's call.
- Check-runs on this head at read time: 41 runs, none failed or cancelled; 12 still in progress (Test Core 1/8 and 2/8, Live E2E UI, Build Core, Type Check consumer gates / workspace / source gates / debt ledger, Lint docs and code guards / ESLint / repo and tooling gates / CI, release and engine gates). Completed and green: Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint PM dispatch-gates, the three scoped lints, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate. The seat reads the twelve to completion before adopting; this record judges the design, and a red run among them is not covered by it.

### ④ Design judgment

In all four the developer ruled the literal right and the reference answer wrong. Each ruling holds against `main`.

- `flows-triggers-approvals.json` eval 20, `type: 'subflow'`. `subflow` is a member of the flow node type enum (`packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts:69`) and the node table row at `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:76` teaches it with bare `config.flowName`, the dependency closure and `outside-closure`. A node is written `type: 'subflow'`, so the literal is the authored spelling and the old prose "A `subflow` node" was the weaker side. The new text is that spelling in place; the rest of the sentence (`config: { flowName: 'notify_owner' }`, the `dependencies` entry, the run-time failure) is untouched and still agrees with line 76. Holds.
- `integrations-declared.json` eval 2, `dialect: 'cel'`. The new reference answer is the Stripe recipe at `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md:52-53` verbatim in both envelopes (`bal.body.available[0].amount / 100.0`, `isoDatetime(now())`), and the envelope rule at `SKILL.md:241` (compute with `{ dialect: 'cel', source: '…' }`; a bare string is literal text) makes the old "via CEL (bare expressions)" reading the one an agent could copy wrongly. The literal is there for the right reason, not pasted: the envelope is what a `fields` value slot requires. Every other clause (connector, `type: 'schedule'`, `runAs: 'system'`, `input: {}`, `filter`, `requires`) is unchanged and matches the recipe. Holds.
- `filters-pagination-search.json` eval 2, `keyset`. `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md:247` writes "For **keyset** paging (infinite scroll ...)" in lower case and `rules/pagination.md` gives the same `where` + `orderBy` + `limit` pattern the answer describes. The miss was case-only ("Keyset" at sentence start); "Use keyset paging:" fixes it without changing the claim. Holds.
- `analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` eval 1, `dataset`. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` teaches that a widget binds a `dataset` and selects named `dimensions` + `values`, with `dataset: 'crm_sales'` on the widget, and the spec says `dataset` is required on a widget (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts:268`, 1011). The old text held only `defineDataset` (capital D), so the lower-case key was absent; "each widget names it in `dataset`" states the widget key truthfully. Holds.

Attempts to break it: a new `must_not_contain` collision in any of the four (none, listed in ①); a reference answer that contains the literal while teaching something `main` refuses (none: each literal is in the form the skill or recipe writes); drift between the changeset prose and the diff (none).

Findings:

- nit — the PR body's re-measure table heads its columns "misses" without a unit; the figures are evals with a miss, not literals (data 3 evals / 6 literals, objectui 17 / 27). The card uses the same unit, so nothing is wrong; prose only.
- nit — in `analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` eval 1 the literal `dataset` is a plain lower-case word any answer about datasets contains, so it discriminates little even now that the reference answer holds it. The assertion is outside this card's "fix the wrong side" ruling and is unchanged by the diff; a follow-up could tighten it to `dataset: '`. No effect on this change.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
